summary: Maintain bounded mission duration samples incrementally for advisory estimates

replay.detail: Projection flush and graph replay rebuild derived duration samples from existing accepted step and person-work claims. Claim meaning and canonical ordering are unchanged.

schema.detail: Add local_run_eta_samples and local_run_eta_pending with indexes and dirty-run triggers. Samples retain the latest 64 completed selected-attempt durations per definition hash and step path; old claims remain unchanged.

rules.detail: Scheduling, checkpoint and retention authority are unchanged; samples only inform advisory estimates.

compatibility.detail: Derived local tables are explicitly classified as member-local, rebuildable projections outside shared digests. They are not replicated and introduce no new wire fields or claim kinds.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon replacement installs additive local tables and backfills samples once. Existing data requires no destructive migration.

manual.detail: No operator action or configuration is required.

recovery.detail: Rollback leaves additive local tables unused. A subsequent upgrade reuses or rebuilds them from retained claims. No original data is rewritten or removed.
